meta.title: Hyatt Regency Danang *Not sponsored*  our honest review and hotel tour. The best in all our travels!
meta.description:
Hi friends, join us as we spend two amazing days at the Hyatt Regency in Danang while we share with you all that we did on the amazing resort situated next to the beautiful Noc Nuon Beach. Noc Nuon is a short drive away from Mykhe and is a more private beach.  
Join us on our hotel tour and other adventures.
